blacklistabilityReview.evidence: thSLVR is deployed on Ethereum at 0x84c8f334434fb6ff769f760653feb88838357039 (ERC-1967 proxy over Sourcify exact-match MetalToken 0x899140a8394b9c6a4c51b7ecc529ffbcd3ff82da, verified 2026-09-17, read at block 26507594 on 2026-11-27). Verified MetalToken.sol inherits ERC20Upgradeable, ERC20BurnableUpgradeable, ERC20PermitUpgradeable, Ownable2StepUpgradeable, and UUPSUpgradeable with no pause, blacklist, transfer fee, or transfer hook. The verdict stays possible because Theo's 2-day TimelockController (0x2bb4b7e6e83fa6b77d0143dad631843cb73dca02) owns the UUPS proxy and can upgrade the implementation; mint is gated to the 4-of-6 Operator Safe (0x94877640dd9e6f1e3cb56bf7b5665b7152601295).
